Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: Only the client can terminate the agreement without cause, with immediate effect, and without paying for completed work, leaving you uncompensated.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon providing written notice, and the Client shall pay for all Services performed up to the date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work transfers to the client upon delivery rather than upon full payment, meaning you could lose your intellectual property rights before you are paid.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to Client upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable.

findings.explanation: Payment terms of Net 90 require you to wait three months for payment, creating significant cash flow difficulties.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. - In the relevant clause regarding termination, only the client can terminate without notice and without paying for completed work, leaving the freelancer uncompensated; I propose that either party may terminate this Agreement upon providing written notice, and the Client shall pay for all Services performed up to the date of termination. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, ownership transfers to the client upon delivery rather than upon full payment, meaning the freelancer could lose intellectual property rights before being paid; I propose that all intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to Client upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable. - In the relevant clause about payment terms, invoices are payable Net 90, which requires waiting three months for payment and creates significant cash flow difficulties; I propose that invoices are payable Net 30. Thank you, and I look forward to working together. Best regards,
